text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking by the outdoor
stage...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Pleeease? I'd really appreciate your
help!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Well, Falco's asking us to help her
create a new
song.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The song's theme is "bespectacled girls
in love."
That's why she chose Ikuno,
Rob Roy, and me to
aid her.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehe! It's all about looking the part with
this kind
of thing! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, the song's composition is pretty
much
finished, but it's still missing
something...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to make a song, I want to do
it right
and really sell everyone on the
charm of glasses
wearers! So please help
me! Pleasepleaseplease
pleeeeease!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I have no problem with helping you, but
what
exactly is it you would like us to
do?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Many characters you see with glasses are

portrayed as being clever, serious, and
calm.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But isn't that, like, a stereotype? I wanna
capture
a more realistic portrayal that
communicates the
true feelings of
glasses-wearing girls!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And while I'm at it, I'd like to show off
their
cuteness and maturity, as well as
how bittersweet
love is.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hm... May I make a suggestion?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Even if we all put our heads together, it
will likely
take some time to reach a
solution. Perhaps we
should split up the
work.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, so what exactly should we do?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I say we leave the story and lyrics to Rob
Roy and
the planning to Hayahide.
Falco, you can help
further establish the
vision of the song.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I will act as your manager. If we devote
ourselves
to the areas in which we
individually excel, we
should be able to
put on an extraordinary
performance.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy. I would like you to base the
lyrics on all
the stories you know which
involve glasses and
your own lived
experience wearing them.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see... If that's what you want, then I
think I can
do it!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Falco, you're the best suited for
arranging the
choreography. Please
incorporate the motions of
wearing
glasses and imbue them with the charm
of
Umadols.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Can do! One cute glasses dance, coming
up! ☆

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I assume I'm being tasked with
brainstorming how
to best utilize both
the choreography and the
song in our
performance?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Correct. Under your planning, I think we
can put
together an even higher-quality
final
performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Finished! Thanks to all of your help, I've
managed
to put together an amazing
new song! ☆

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations. I'm happy to have been
of help.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations. I'm happy to have been
of help.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I agree! You were really wonderful! You
were just
like a real manager!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy and I both tend to get overly
engrossed
in our work and lose track of
time. I really
appreciate you keeping us
on schedule.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hehe. It's an honor to hear you say that.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Well, then. We've gone above and
beyond with
our work, so why don't we
all take a break now?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus possesses such a wonderful

competence that makes her a great
leader. We
can't help but be awed by
her once again.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. We can only say we're finished
after we
have performed the song. Let's
begin rehearsing
right away.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, under Ikuno Dictus's capable
direction as
manager, they begin
practicing.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: La la la! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wait a minute... Why do Rob Roy and I
have to
sing as well?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That was fantastic! You're practically
radiating
Umadol majesty! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, they formally name their idol
group
"Glasses Outclasses" and put on a
concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that great success, Ikuno Dictus's
glasses
gain an extra bright gleam to
them.
